blogs.title: Stop Asking LLMs for Answers—Ask Them for the Rules Instead
blogs.description: An introductory post explaining the core philosophy of FeatLLM: shifting the role of Large Language Models from 'black-box predictors' to 'expert feature engineers.' It explains how turning an LLM's reasoning into a set of binary rules allows for faster, cheaper, and more transparent tabular predictions.

blogs.title: The Small Data Miracle: High-Performance AI with Only a Few Examples
blogs.description: This post focuses on the 'few-shot' aspect of the paper. It explores how FeatLLM uses the prior general knowledge embedded in LLMs (like medical or financial common sense) to outperform traditional machine learning models that typically require thousands of rows of data to be accurate.

blogs.title: Cutting the AI Bill: How FeatLLM Solves the Cost and Latency of LLM Inference
blogs.description: A practitioner-focused blog post discussing the efficiency gains of the FeatLLM framework. It highlights how the model eliminates the need to query an LLM for every single data row during inference, drastically reducing API costs and prediction latency while maintaining high accuracy.

blogs.title: Taming the Table: Overcoming Prompt Limits and Noisy Data
blogs.description: A deeper dive into the technical strategies used in FeatLLM, specifically focusing on feature bagging and ensemble methods. This post explains how these techniques allow the framework to handle massive tables that would normally crash an LLM's context window and how it filters out 'spurious correlations' (irrelevant data).
